reuse.why: The new action reuses getBulkBudgetCategories, averageToBudget and getSheetValue, but the #fixed check is a new FIXED_TAG regex instead of the existing extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags.

duplication.why: All exclusions sit once in the shared selector; the only overlap is the hand-written tag regex and setLastMonthSpending's loop that mirrors the average actions' structure.

placement.why: The template, #fixed and hidden exclusions all go into the shared getBulkBudgetCategories in server/budget/actions.ts, and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts next to the others.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps, though c.goal_def is added to getBudgetData's SELECT without being used.

maintainability.why: One selection function owns every exclusion with a single flag; small smells are the regex tag parser that can diverge from the app's tag parsing and the unused getBudgetData column.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/budget/actions.ts FIXED_TAG regex re-parses group notes instead of using extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags

disguised_duplication.where: FIXED_TAG = /(^|\s)#fixed(?![\w-])/i is a reshaped copy of the tag extraction done by extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories swaps includeHidden for includeHiddenCategories and gains the template and #fixed exclusions as rules for all callers; every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, goes through it
